Moon 3D Gaussian Splat — Artemis II Data

Author: Nicolas Diolez
Scene: https://superspl.at/scene/2ac8f423
Viewer: https://superspl.at/s?id=2ac8f423
Author profile: https://superspl.at/user/nicolasdiolez
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The scene description credits the source photographs to NASA Johnson Space
Center and the Artemis II crew.

This repository bundles the scene's original native SOG v2 files into the
single generated/moon.sog ZIP container expected by SOGLoader. No images were
transcoded and no Gaussians, spherical-harmonic bands, or palette entries were
removed. The payload contains 4,929,011 unique Gaussians and its complete SH3
payload.

Bundled SHA-256:
70b427c1673058954b6ad80e48a65bd78d631834206f199a2acdce07968c11c8

The ZIP container is canonicalized with a fixed 2020-01-01 timestamp and no
local user/OS metadata. Native payload files are byte-for-byte unchanged.
